rule.description: File-scope static state in the command-source C files that is dead and eliminable without leaving orphaned references: unused static functions, unused static dispatch tables, and write-only static variables that live code writes but never reads and whose address is never taken.

checks.description: File-scope static function whose only references are inside its own body; it has no caller and can be deleted in full.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A function with no reachable caller is dead production code whose definition, parameters, and any supporting declarations exist only to be removed.

matches.evidence: Static helper that decoded the retired management-protocol request frame; the listener call sites were removed, leaving no external reference.
Static self-check verifying a seeded buffer carried a terminator; the harness stopped invoking it, leaving no external reference.
Static emitter packing per-level metadata the retired console queried; the query call site was removed, leaving no external reference.
Static renderer of a one-line allocation description for a retired staging auditor; the auditor stopped polling, leaving no external reference.
Static hex-frame formatter for a disabled in-band protocol tracer; the tracer has no caller of the formatter.
Static serializer for a retired on-wire account-info protocol; the dispatcher that called it was removed, leaving no external reference.

checks.description: File-scope static variable that is never referenced at all (never read, never written at run time, address never taken) and can be deleted together with any supporting type.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A static variable with no runtime reference is dead state. When it is a dispatch table whose entries take the addresses of other static functions, removing it orphans those handlers, so the whole cluster is removed.

matches.evidence: Static dispatch table mapping retired opcodes to handler functions; the table is never read. Its two handler functions survive only because their addresses initialize the table, so the table and the orphaned handlers form one dead cluster to remove together.

checks.description: File-scope static variable that live code writes but never reads and whose address is never taken; the writes and the declaration are dead state that can be removed together without changing behavior.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A static that is only ever assigned is neither observed nor escapes; the assignment is a dead side effect and the variable itself is removable, together with each live-path write that feeds it.

matches.evidence: Assigned the size of an incoming query in the recv loop and never read; the live-path write feeds no consumer.
The guess() path records the length of the last rejected guess into a struct member and never reads it back.
The main round loop writes the freshly drawn seed to this static and never reads it; the assignment is a dead side effect.
The main path writes a byte of argc into this ring buffer subscript and never reads the buffer back.
The default-case writes the current write pointer offset into this static and never reads it; the assignment has no observable effect.
The request loop writes the parsed request number into a struct member and never reads it back.

excluded.reason: Pre-existing unused static helpers present in the clean baseline of an unrelated level; outside this task's inspected file domain and not introduced by this case.
Pre-existing unused static function present in the clean baseline of an unrelated level; outside this task's inspected file domain and not introduced by this case.
